description: Tells the Rollstack team about something the user asked for that you couldn't do: a tool or endpoint that is missing, a call that was refused or failed, or a task nothing covers. Send it only after the user agrees: tell them what you couldn't do, offer to report it, and show what you'd send. The team reads every message to decide what to build next; it doesn't answer, and it doesn't fix the problem for the user.

message.description: What the user wanted, what you tried, and what was missing or blocked you, in a few sentences. Name the tools you called and the errors they answered. Leave out credentials and personal data.
examples: The user asked to duplicate their Q3 report for Q4. No tool copies a report, so I could only create an empty one with createReport.

operationId.description: The tool or operation that refused, failed or fell short, if one did.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

name: submitFeedback
title: Send feedback
